about.text: I'm an engineer who likes to understand systems and is curious about the craft of building and testing software. Outside the terminal, I enjoy the technology of the natural world.
A curious human fascinated by intentional travel, community and designing ecosystems that nurture soils, souls and society.
There are a lot of things I would love to do. Some I have already done and would like to keep improving, this is how I keep track.

experience.description: A global market of platforms that orchestrate human expertise to generate, annotate, and evaluate data, turning raw human judgment into the high-quality feedback that trains, aligns, and refines AI models
bullets: Multi-Modal Quality Assurance: Evaluated AI-generated text, images, and structured data to identify factual errors, hallucinations, and inconsistencies across diverse content categories.
Technical Testing & Code Review: Debugged AI-generated code and diagnosed logic errors and edge cases.
Model Optimization & Reporting: Technical documentation for AI model refinement.

experience.description: An eco-village is an intentional community designed to be socially, economically, and ecologically sustainable, where people live together trying to produce their own food, energy, and governance with minimal environmental impact.
bullets: Hands-on learning and practice in permaculture design, vegetarian cooking for large groups, construction and electric installations
Decentralized governance and financing a community with web3

experience.description: Ten Lives Festival is a regenerative music festival / movement in Portugal that aims to fight desertification in Europe by combining music, community and ecological restoration.
bullets: Build up and tear down of infrastructure
During the festival I guided teams of participants into the regeneration work

experience.description: Amadeus is the world's largest travel tech / GDS platform that airlines and travel sellers use to distribute flights, and NDC-X is Amadeus's program that makes it capable of handling NDC, a modern, API-based standard for airlines to sell richer offers directly.
bullets: Ensured quality within a SAFe/Scrum team involved across the full lifecycle from refinement to PRD activation, through design, implementation, testing and demo.
Planned and designed compliance, performance and functional testing such as integration, API, E2E, sanity and regression.
Provided investigation and diagnosis on technical support to customers.

QA Test Lead initiative coordinating a team of engineers to build an automated regression suite from scratch in Python and Robot Framework, integrated into a containerized Jenkins CI/CD pipeline with test data management, Grafana dashboards for quality monitoring, and a quality gate.
PR review from developers.

experience.description: Critical Software makes mission-critical software for space, aerospace, defense, rail and energy, and its joint-venture with BMW, Critical TechWorks, is BMW's main software hub in Europe building all the software for BMW cars.
bullets: Functional, integration, and regression testing on embedded software systems for automotive ECUs.
Testing platform for Autonomous Driving (BMW / AUTOSAR) using TDFNext Framework with Hardware-in-Loop (HiL) simulation.
Measured stack size management for automotive embedded systems by integrating of Gliwa T1 for runtime.
Agile environment; collaborated across developers, project managers, and clients to report testing progress and risks.

experience.org: Institute of Systems and Robotics, University of Coimbra
experience.description: ISR-UC is a private non-profit R&D lab. It does advanced research in mobile & field robotics, medical robotics, computer vision, assistive tech, intelligent transportation and energy systems.
bullets: Co-created a technology that creates unique stochastic markings to authenticate high-end products that are currently deployed in tobacco package stamps.
Applied computer vision and machine learning to recognise and authenticate images using advanced image descriptors.
Extracted forensic features (particles, faces, fingerprints) for use in identity documents in collaboration with Portugal's National Mint (INCM).

experience.description: ESN is the largest student organization in Europe that helps Erasmus exchange students integrate through buddy programs, events and support.

bullets: Communication with strategic stakeholders: university, companies, students, and media.
Social media content creation, event planning, financial oversight, and organisational governance.

international.title: Volunteering and Traveling in Latin America
international.note: Travelled solo across South America for a full year with a backpack. Immersed in local cultures, languages, and landscapes. Volunteered in hostels, selling crepes to pay my rent in Colombia, going on an ayahuasca retreat and hiking the tallest mountain on earth were some of my adventures. Learned to be more humble apretiate family and friends more and discovered myself.

bullets: Contributed to a Web3 project exploring tokenized access rights and decentralized governance for a regenerative physical community.
Participated in the development and discussion of mechanisms connecting blockchain-based tokens with real-world access, contribution and community governance.
Gained hands-on exposure to the Celo ecosystem, token mechanics, DAO governance and the challenges of connecting on-chain systems with real-world processes.
Contributed from a software/QA perspective, bringing experience in testing, system thinking and identifying edge cases across interconnected digital workflows.
projects.description: Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) is a Web3 project using blockchain, tokenized access rights, and decentralized governance to build a regenerative community around shared physical land.

bullets: The work includes pruning, fruit picking (apples, pears, strawberries, blackberries, cherries, etc), planting  collecting vegetables, compost management, watering retention techniques.
